def share_same_measurement_R575_binding(summary):
    """Lossless named sharing only of the same actual R575 binding object.

    Numerical result.json is untouched. The reference source remains literally
    present in the same measurement row. Unknown shapes/unequal objects remain
    literal. The complete header is counted before choosing the shorter form.
    """
    original = canonical(summary)
    answer = copy.deepcopy(summary)
    if answer.get("schema") == SERIES_SCHEMA:
        containers = answer.get("levels")
        if not isinstance(containers, list):
            return summary
        kind = "series_levels"
    else:
        containers = [answer]
        kind = "one_measurement"
    references = []
    marker = "R581_same_measurement_original_R575_binding"
    for index, row in enumerate(containers):
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        reference = row.get("actual_reference_angle_projection_defect")
        analytic = row.get("actual_analytic_angle_projection_defect")
        if not isinstance(reference, dict) or not isinstance(analytic, dict):
            continue
        old_summary = reference.get("original_R575_summary")
        new_summary = analytic.get("original_R580_summary")
        if not isinstance(old_summary, dict) or not isinstance(new_summary, dict):
            continue
        old_binding = old_summary.get("binding")
        new_binding = new_summary.get("binding")
        if not isinstance(old_binding, dict) or not isinstance(new_binding, dict):
            continue
        if "actual_R575_binding" not in new_binding:
            continue
        actual = new_binding["actual_R575_binding"]
        if not isinstance(actual, dict) or canonical(actual) != canonical(old_binding):
            continue
        references.append(dict(container_index=index,
            complete_binding_identity=value_identity(actual)))
        new_binding["actual_R575_binding"] = {marker:index}
    if not references:
        return summary
    answer["R581_named_same_evaluation_bindings"] = dict(
        schema="R581-same-measurement-complete-R575-binding-reference-v1",
        container_kind=kind,
        source_fields=["actual_reference_angle_projection_defect","original_R575_summary","binding"],
        destination_fields=["actual_analytic_angle_projection_defect","original_R580_summary",
            "binding","actual_R575_binding"],
        reference_marker=marker, references=references,
        complete_unshared_selected_identity=dict(bytes=len(original),sha256=sha(original)),
        exact_complete_object_equality_checked_with_original_canonical_JSON=True,
        source_remains_literal_in_the_same_measurement=True,
        missing_null_types_signed_zero_and_unknown_fields_unchanged=True,
        inverse="expand_same_measurement_R575_binding")
    return answer if len(canonical(answer)) < len(original) else summary


def expand_same_measurement_R575_binding(summary):
    """Declared metadata inverse; not run as a writer test or scientific gate."""

    table = answer.pop("R581_named_same_evaluation_bindings", None)
    if table is None:
        return answer
    require(table.get("schema") ==
        "R581-same-measurement-complete-R575-binding-reference-v1",
        "Use the declared same-evaluation binding representation")
    kind = table["container_kind"]
    require(kind in ("one_measurement","series_levels"),
        "Use the explicit measurement or actual-series container")
    containers = [answer] if kind == "one_measurement" else answer["levels"]
    require(table["source_fields"] ==
        ["actual_reference_angle_projection_defect","original_R575_summary","binding"]
        and table["destination_fields"] ==
        ["actual_analytic_angle_projection_defect","original_R580_summary",
            "binding","actual_R575_binding"]
        and table["reference_marker"] == "R581_same_measurement_original_R575_binding",
        "Only the one named binding relation may be expanded")
    seen = set()
    for row in table["references"]:
        index = row["container_index"]
        require(type(index) is int and 0 <= index < len(containers) and index not in seen,
            "Each actual measurement container occurs once")
        seen.add(index)
        target = containers[index]
        source = target["actual_reference_angle_projection_defect"]["original_R575_summary"]["binding"]
        destination = target["actual_analytic_angle_projection_defect"]["original_R580_summary"]["binding"]
        require(value_identity(source) == row["complete_binding_identity"]
            and destination["actual_R575_binding"] ==
                {"R581_same_measurement_original_R575_binding":index},
            "Expand the exact complete same-measurement source")
        destination["actual_R575_binding"] = copy.deepcopy(source)
    raw = canonical(answer)
    require(dict(bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(raw)) == table["complete_unshared_selected_identity"],
        "The complete original selected body must be recovered")
    return answer
